summary: E-mail about MV DUNLIN GATE arrives in the operations inbox: MV DUNLIN GATE - Red Sea passage declined (war risks)

email.from: Owner's vessel technical management (Dunlin Gate Shipping, fictional) <technical@dunlingate-shipping.example>
email.subject: MV DUNLIN GATE - Red Sea passage declined (war risks)
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV DUNLIN GATE, Mundra to Gijon

Following the security advisory issued overnight on attacks on merchant ships in the southern Red Sea, owners have decided, in the reasonable judgement of the Master and owners, not to proceed through Bab el-Mandeb or the Red Sea. We rely on the war risks clause of the charter party.

Please give alternative orders. We propose the passage via the Cape of Good Hope. The Master has been told to keep well clear of the area while awaiting your orders.

Best regards,
Marine department
Owner's vessel technical management (Dunlin Gate Shipping, fictional)
